summary: GenOil Inc. furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, signed by CEO David Lifschultz. The filing is an ordinary periodic financial disclosure by a foreign private issuer, with no transaction, corporate action, or special situation. Balance sheet totals $125 in assets against $553,154 in liabilities; net loss was $1,644,333 on nil revenue, driven largely by $1,485,000 of stock-based compensation. Shares outstanding were 2,030,406,929. No deal terms, advisors, board recommendations, or regulatory clocks are stated.
